items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: The interviewer asks 'His brother was with him.' The interviewee does not confirm this relationship or mention a brother in the subsequent text, instead listing other band members (Porter, Coleman, Gishard, etc.).

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, he was always a rescue for me from the first time I came to New Orleans. He was like a guiding angel. And so he told me, he said, My, my boys in my band want you to play with the band. He said, and all I'll do, I'll do, I'll just, um, um, wipe the doors and attend to the business. He said, because I don't like to play much anymore. Because Joe used to like to gamble anyhow. And he before doing that, when I began to get older, then play. And he said, you can play all these special arrangements. And,…

Dennis Gishaw was playing bass, Samuel Dutre was playing tenor, we had another alto player, we used to call him Singary for nickname, he went to Cincinnati, I forget his name. Singary? Singary. We called him Singary for the cigarette. I don't know him. He was great alto player, well he and Gene Porter were close, and so they went on the boat. I left, I went with, I didn't go in the band, he said Don Albert is here. I said Don Albert has a bigger band and they're doing much traveling and he needs you much more…
